label: Matrix
description: Rooms and messages of a homeserver
agentGuide: Base path /_matrix/client/v3. Me: GET .../account/whoami. Rooms I am in: GET .../joined_rooms; a room's name: GET .../rooms/<room_id>/state/m.room.name; resolve #alias:server: GET .../directory/room/<encoded alias>. Read: GET .../rooms/<room_id>/messages?dir=b&limit=30 (chunk[] with sender, content.body, origin_server_ts). Send: PUT .../rooms/<room_id>/send/m.room.message/<unique txn id> {"msgtype": "m.text", "body": "..."} (add format: "org.matrix.custom.html" and formatted_body for HTML). Join: POST .../join/<room id or alias>; create: POST .../createRoom {"name": "...", "invite": ["@user:server"]}. Encrypted rooms cannot be read through this API. The token is set by Allkin.
